summary: Morpheus enters the cockpit beside Dozer and asks whether Zion sent the warning; Dozer says no, another ship (Big Brother) is running a parallel pipeline. As Morpheus watches the decaying sewer main pass and Neo and Trinity crowd in behind him, an alarm begins to sound. Dozer reports a Squiddy (a Sentinel) sweeping in fast; Morpheus orders him to set the ship down in a nearby supply line. Neo asks what a Squiddy is; Trinity and Dozer explain it is a Sentinel, a killing machine built to search and destroy. The ship rocks as it squeezes into a tiny supply line.

what_changes.before: Cruising through the sewer main, only learning that another ship runs a parallel pipeline.
what_changes.after: Under active threat as a Sentinel sweeps in, forcing them to dive for cover.
what_changes.evidence: An ALARM BEGINS TO SOUND. DOZER Shit, Squiddy's sweeping in quick.

what_changes.before: Moving openly through the sewer main.
what_changes.after: Hidden inside a tiny supply line to escape the Sentinel.
what_changes.evidence: MORPHEUS Set it down in there. ... Neo feels the ship rock to the side as it squeezes into a tiny supply line.

what_changes.after: Told it is a Sentinel, a search-and-destroy killing machine.
what_changes.evidence: NEO Squiddy? TRINITY A Sentinel. It's a killing machine designed for one thing. DOZER Search and destroy.

event_hint.one_line: A Sentinel sweeps in on the ship, forcing the crew to hide in a supply line.
